Smart Marine Vessels
Digitalization For Marine Vessels
Digitalization and automation in the maritime industry has been growing at a rapid pace in the maritime industry. Early adopters have 
leveraged it and gained increased competitiveness and enchanced operational efficiency. Additionally, these steps have contributed to the decarbonisation effort and helped owners towards its carbon neutral goals for its fleet. Realtime data from smart sensors have given deep real-time insights into vessels operations not commonly seen in the maritime industry. These have resulted in enhanced monitoring, quality assurance, verification, and ease of reporting. Digitalization has opened a unique window for owners to review and re-enginner their fleet that will have implicattions to their competitiveness and both short and longer-term sustainability of their business.
